label: DEV — re-scored existing pinned trials; the gate runs on the post-fix packet whose fixes were motivated by these items (optimistic for the gate)
unit: trials (11 pinned questions x 2 reps per cell); frontier does the work, policy decides autonomous vs fallback
findings: Sonnet: the deterministic gate adds nothing (frontier already acts/abstains correctly on this cohort).
Haiku: gate AND frontier removes acting on non-answer gold (1->0) and cuts false autonomy (1->0 packet, 2->1 raw) for ~5pt coverage; gate alone is worse than frontier (legality != correctness).

Reading: the deterministic gate is a safety bound for cheaper/weaker executors, not an improvement over a strong frontier; learned confidence not yet tested (#55 falsification needs it to beat this gate + unconditional escalation).
